newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares close up on bonds, more gains ahead.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares close up on bonds, more gains ahead.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Thursday in a quiet May Day market with further gains seen following solid bond rises at home and abroad.

"May Day has inhibited things even it is not a holiday here, it is in much of Europe. Turnover has been ultra low, but we expect more impressive bond-linked rises to come through tomorrow," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 1.39 point up at 156.16 in overall bourse turnover of 713 million crowns. The KFX June future rose 0.55 point to 156.25 with 116 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Danisco and Tele Danmark were among the day's most successful KFX shares, noting gains of seven and six crowns respectively to end at 324 and 386 respectively.
Sophus Berendsen did well too, putting on 10 crowns to close at 810, while Coloplast had a bad day, shedding 14 crowns to finish at 464.
